_readme: Plantburgh Light Meter: what needs Pro and how much the free plan keeps. The app re-reads this file every 6 hours; no app update needed. Pro ids: noAds, dliLog, distance, csv (new ids arrive with app updates). Limits: spots, projects, placedPlants, reportsPerMonth, customLabels. A limit left out uses the app's built-in number. Backups are never limited.
